fields.aka: Candraśekhara Ācārya, Ācāryaratna, Ācāryaśekhara, Candraśekhara Deva
fields.place: Śrīhaṭṭa; Navadvīpa (Vraja-pattana), near Jagannātha Miśra's house
fields.notes:
Uncle of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu: husband of Śacī Devī's sister (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna). Branch of Lord Caitanya (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.13). Performed the rites of the Lord's sannyāsa at Keśava Bhāratī's āśrama in Kāṭoyā.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Śaṅkhanidhi, one of the nine nidhis (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 102); the presence of Candra (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 112).

Maternal grandfather of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Rathītara gotra. Sons: Yogeśvara Paṇḍita, Ratnagarbha Ācārya; daughters: Śacī Devī, Sarvajayā Devī (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna). Expert astrologer; cast Mahāprabhu's horoscope.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Garga Muni and Sumukha Gopa (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 104–105).
